'''Balmgrass''' grew in fields along the shores of the [[Silver Sea/Legends|Silver Sea]],<ref name="NJO Rebirth" /> a body of [[Water/Legends|water]] located near the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]].<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> The [[Grass/Legends|grass]] was consumed by the [[cairnmog]] and [[fecklen]], two [[Species/Legends|species]] of animal that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|world]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Balmgrass first appeared in [[Greg Keyes]]'s [[2001]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]'', the eighth volume of the ''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order]]'' series.<ref name="NJO Rebirth" />
